note: RELATIVE estimate, NOT a bound: Rev F/Rev E change in magnetic near-field coupling for the same circuit and currents. The absolute switcher leakage is unknown. The GND plane's shielding, conducted and capacitive paths and the enclosure are not modelled.
method: Part A, pickup. Sources: the TPS65131 switching loops, each a closed polyline through pad centres, and L1/L2 as vertical point dipoles at the part centre (semi-shielded drum cores; same part and current in both revisions, so only position matters). Victims: closed polylines through pad centres. Between two pads on the same net the polyline follows the routed copper (shortest path over routing.json tracks and vias) in board mode, or the straight pad-to-pad line in plan mode (both revisions alike, so the ratio compares like with like). Between two pins of one part, and on the closing edge, and on GND hops (the In1.Cu plane), it is straight: the plane return is taken to run along that line. That is the low-frequency return; at the MHz switching harmonics a plane return follows the trace and the true area of those plane-return loops is smaller (both revisions alike). Coupling = mutual inductance by the Neumann double line integral over the two polylines (loops) or the flux of the point dipole's vector potential round the victim (inductors); the coplanar dipole estimate mu0 A_s A_v / (4 pi r^3) is reported beside it as a cross-check.

pickup.mode: board: routed copper on both revisions
pickup.units: M_nH is mutual inductance in nH for loop sources; for the inductor dipoles it is the flux per unit dipole moment, Wb/(A m^2) x 1e9. Only the ratios carry meaning.
